book.name: METIU
book.title: Yeisu Wasane Dodohobine Metiu wana Luluweli

content: Tolomo Hotiya I Yok Pwatum
He yan yake Yeisu i setagiim he guwole i lok i la he soge hadidine ge i tuwodau.
Boda lahine suwok si mipase ge si mipainan, bwen i gaesai he wage hotiya ge i tuwodau, agegene bobode si talmidi he mamele.
Habeto i gohalibe iloke bigi hohoyowate i lihuyan heidiye. I nga, “Tolomo hotiya i lok he baguye ge i yok wit pwatumine.
Sauge i yok pwatum, topadine si dobu he hiyede, bwen man si yowo dau ge si hanid.
Topadine si dobu he poepoe pakpakine, hedi poepoe dodohobine taine i dekai. Habekik bwen si siwi, kaiwane poepoe taine i demidau.
Age sauge parae i sai, i yamwanid wit matakabuine bwen si yakiwo, kaiwane hewasidiye taine i desedau vetahe.
Pwatum topadine si dobu he pipisare gamwadiye, bwen pipisare i siwi gaigaisi ge i bib pamate wit yake.
Pwatum topadine si dobu he poepoe dodohobine ge si puwo, tomase tomase hinodiye. Papaine hinodiye ho-sangak, topadine ho-ewone, topadine ho-etuwon.
Hebe batimiu i gan, lo lihulihu ya hu longe.”
Sahe Pakene ge Yeisu I Lihuyan Gohalibe
Yeisu wana topadavae si luwom heine ge si tayak si nga, “Sahe kaiwane u gohalibe bobode heidiye?”
Yeisu i golase halingadiye i nga, “Helak wana bagalogugui hana nuwotu sumosumoine hobak i payoumate heimiu, age taine i depayoumate heidiye.
Sega wana lapu i gan, Helak bwele i tubwen, iloke Helak hana lapu bwele i kai suwok heine. Sega Helak hana lapu taine i degan heine, sahe tankai veto wana lapu, Helak bwele i ho yok.
Pakene a gohalibe heidiye kaiwane si hahayao ege taine si depaidi, si papadavae ege taine si delonge ge si delapu.
Sidiye he wedi ginawi profet Aiseya wana luluweli i tabwa tolosuwok, i nga:

content.text: Bwele hu mimi papadavae, agegene taine hu delonge ge hu delapu,
bwele hu mimi hahayao, agegene taine hu depaidi.
Kaiwane bobode ya hatiyediye i pak,
Akum taine, bwen si paidi he matadiye,
iloke si nuwo pahavile heyau ge a pamoluid.

content: Age humiu hu dohob kaiwane matamiu i wayae ge batimiu i mwapwe.

Tolosuwok a liwo heimiu, profet ge Helak wana bobode dedei si hoyowate nunuwadiye suwok si paidi sahe humiu hu paidi, agegene taine si depaidi, ge nuwadiye suwok si longe sahe humiu hu longe, agegene taine si delonge.
Yeisu I Gopawayae Toyok hana Gohalibe
Gen hu padavae, iloke hu lapu pwatum hana toyok hana gohalibe hana sapu.
Sauge hebe tolomo hotiya i longe Helak wana bagalogugui wasane, age hana sapu taine i delapu, bwele Seitan i luwom ge i ho hwae sahe gane si vahi he hatiyene. Iye te pwatum gane i dobu he hiyede.
Pwatum ga i dobu he poepoe pakpakine, iye te bobode hebwaden wase dodohobine si longe ge tanpeyawate si howo si hotei he hatiyediye bwaine wedi yariyae.

Agegene bigi hotiya, wase dodohobine taine si denunuwotu-yan vetahe he hatiyediye, hewasidiye taine i desedau vetahe, iyete wedi sauge taine i demwalao. Sauge hebe si paidi puyowo o hebe bobode si patilaoid wase dodohobine kaiwane, tanpeyawate si pi yayaluwadiye ge si boleu.

Pwatum ga i dobu he pipisare gamwadiye, iye te bobode hebwaden wase dodohobine si longe, age si nunuwotu panayawi yawedine kaiwane ge si nuwo gogomwau, iyete bigibigi hebwaden ya si bib pamate wase dodohobine ge taine hinone i degan.
Pwatum gane i dobu he poepoe dodohobine, iye te bobode hebwaden wase dodohobine si longe ge si lapu hana sapu. Si puwo, papaine hinodiye ho-sangak, papaine ho-ewone, papaine ho-etuwon.”
Nan Ngakngakine ge Wit Si Siwi Toyao hana Gohalibe
Yeisu i lihuyan gohalibe hotiya hedi heidiye i nga, “Helak wana bagalogugui sohode ti ya. Tolomo hotiya i yok wit pwatumine dodohobine he wana baguye.
Gogou hotiya bobode bwabwaligadiye si hiyene, bwen hana siviye hotiya i luwom ge i yok nan ngakngakine pwatumine he wit gamwadiye, habeto i yogo.
Sauge wit i siwi ge i telipune i puwo, bwen nan ngakngakine i youmate hedi.
Tolomo yake wana tokaiwo si luwom heine si nga, ‘Gamalak, wit pwatumine dodohobine u yok he lam baguye, age? Agegene nan ngakngakine i hudi igohoi?’
I golase halingadiye i nga, ‘Siviye hotiya i ginawi tei.’ Wana tokaiwo si liwo si nga, ‘Tab nuwam hamai ha lok ge ha puik yok?’
I golase halingadiye i nga, ‘Tab, kaiwane hebe nan ngakngakine hu puik yok, bwele hoge hu puik hebo wit.

Gen si toiwo si siwi toyao, hana had pasepase hana sauge. He saugeine yake a liwo topasepase heidiye a nga: Nan ngakngakine gen hu puik deiyan ge hu kin bwele ta ton, habeto wit hu yomo ge hu pase he lo guwole.’ ”
Hayao Pwatumine hana Gohalibe
Yeisu i lihuyan gohalibe hotiya hedi heidiye, i nga, “Helak wana bagalogugui sohode hayao pwatumine, tolomo hotiya i howo ge i vahi he wana malahao.

Pwatum hohoyowate gamwadiye iye i tankai suwok, agegene sauge i siwi ge i kai, bwen i kai lakeid bigi hohoyowate hebwaden si siwi he malahao. I tabwa hibwahi lahine hotiya bwen man hebwaden si iviwowo he hauhawal hedi win si ginawi he yahahane.”
Yis hana Gohalibe

Yeisu i lihuyan gohalibe hotiya hedi, i nga, “Helak wana bagalogugui sohode yis, vaini hotiya i howo ge i hotei pwalawa hana kaikai sohode beg ho-tuwon he gamwane, habeto yis i kaiwo hana had i tuk soleyan pwalawa bwabwaligane.”
Yeisu i gohalibe iloke bigibigi hebwaden yake bwabwaligane i lihuyan bobode heidiye; he gohalibe ege te bigibigi topadine i lihuyan heidiye.
Iloke profet wana lihulihu i tabwa tolosuwok i nga:

content.text: Hawau a pwe ge a gohalibe;
hebwaden si musumo saugeine veto panayawi i telipune hana had sauge ya.

content: Yeisu I Gopawayae Nan Ngakngakine hana Gohalibe
Habeto Yeisu i seyokid boda ge i la i setuk he guwole. Wana topadavae si luwom heine si nga, “Nan ngakngakine i siwi he baguye hana gohalibe gen u gopawayae heyai.”
I golase halingadiye i nga, “Tolomo gane wit pwatumine dodohobine i yok, iye te Tolomo Natune.
Baguye iye te panayawi, ge wit pwatumine dodohobine iye te Helak wana bagalogugui bobodeidiye. Nan ngakngakine iye te Seitan wana bobode,
ge siviye gane nan ngakngakine pwatumine i yok, iye te Seitan. Pasepase hana sauge iye te sauge mwaomwaoine, ge topasepase sidiye te anelose-yan.
“Nan ngakngakine si puik yok ge si ton he hiwo, iye te bwele sohode hedi he sauge mwaomwaoine.

Bwele Tolomo Natune wana anelose-yan i patileid, bwen si puik yok he wana bagalogugui bigi hohoyowate hebwaden si pasopiyeleid bobode ge si gegi, sohode hedi bobode bwabwaligadiye hebwaden page ngakngakine si ginginawi.
Habeto si yok tukanid he hiwo lahine gamwane iloke si tantan ge si sangsangapatad ngingidiye.
Bwen tosapu-yan si tale sohode parae Tamadiye he wana bagalogugui. Hebe batimiu i gan, lo lihulihu ya hu longe.”
Gogomwau Si Holem ge Bak Dodohobine Suwok hedi Gohalibe

Helak wana bagalogugui sohode hedi gogomwau lahine si holem he baguye hotiya ge si mate yok. Tolomo hotiya i sepaidi habe i ho sumwan pahavile hedi. I yariyae suwok gogomwau yake kaiwane, iloke i la wana bigibigi hoyowate i paliyan, bwen maniine i howo ge i pamaise baguye yake.
Helak wana bagalogugui sohode hedi ti ya. Gogomwau hana topali hotiya i luweniid bak dodohobidiye.
Sauge hotiya, bak dodohobine suwok maisane lahine i paidi, ilok i la wana bigibigi hohoyowate i paliyan, bwen maniine i howo ge i pamaise bak yake.
Waimu hana Gohalibe
Helak wana bagalogugui sohode hedi waimu si gaeyan he soge, iloke yalogi tomase ge tomase si huwone.
Sauge i susuwoku, tologi si momod senge he kelekele. Habeto si tuwodau, ilok yalogi si lohaseid, hebwaden dodohobidiye si dohe he kekehe, hebwaden ngakngakidiye si yomo yokid.
Bwele sohode ti yake he sauge mwaomwaoine. Anelose-yan si luwom, tongak ge todohob si yomo teiid tomase, hebwaden si ngak si yomo vevekid.
Habeto si yok tukanid he hiwo lahine gamwane, iloke si tantan ge si sangsangapatad ngingidiye.
Papalapu Tovevai ge Papalapu Totoyaune
Yeisu i tayakid wana topadavae i nga, “Tab nuwamiu i sapu lihulihu hebwaden ya kaiwadiye?” Si golase halingane si nga, “Bam.”

I liwo heidiye i nga, “Logugui hana topapalapu bwabwaligadiye, hebwaden hobak si padavae-yan Helak wana bagalogugui, sidiye sohode guwole tonuwage gane bigibigi tovevai ge bigibigi totoyaune i yomo he wana bagasolavi ge i hotei taganid.”
Naseret Bobodeidiye Taine Si Dehawatau-yan Yeisu
Saugeine Yeisu i gomwao gohalibe hebwaden ya, habe i seyok hiyebe yake
i lok i la totone he habane. I papalapu bobode he wedi guwole tapwalolo, bwen nuwadiye si hape si nga, “Wana lapu ya i howo igohoi? Mwatan ge bosowaine pamali yauyawate i ginawiid?
Iye kapenta natune, age? Tinane hidane Meri, he-hauhavane Jems, Josep, Saimon ge Judas.
He-lulune bwabwaligadiye mwage he-bwaide-yan. Sohode ti yo, age? Age wana lapu ge wana sibe ya i howo igohoi?”
Iyete si hata mamaliye-yan Yeisu. Yeisu i liwo heidiye i nga, “Bobode bwabwaligadiye si hawatau-yan profet, agegene he-tutuine ge habane bobodeidiye ege taine si dehawatau-yan.”
Pamali yauyawate taine i dehoyowate i deginawiid he hiyebe yake, kaiwane taine si degoru heine.
